knowledge_point.title: Identifying the Local Area Scale Factor of a Transformation

question.:question/problem:
Consider a small rectangle $Δ$ whose bottom-left corner is located at the point $(0,2)$ with sides parallel to the coordinate axes in the $uv$-plane and whose area is $\delta A.$ Which of the following gives the best approximation for the area of the image of this rectangle under the action of the transformation $T,$ given by

$$
T:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{bmatrix}- v^{2} + \cos{\left(u \right)}\\u + v\end{bmatrix}?
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Recall that the absolute value of the Jacobian determinant gives the local area scale factor of the transformation at that point:

$$
\text{Area}(T(Δ))\approx\left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|\cdot\underbrace{\text{Area}(Δ)}_{\delta A}
$$

Computing the corresponding Jacobian determinant, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)} & =\begin{vmatrix}\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}\\\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}\end{vmatrix}\\& =\begin{vmatrix}- \sin{\left(u \right)}&- 2 v\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\\& =(- \sin{\left(u \right)})\cdot (1)-(- 2 v)\cdot (1)\\& =-\sin u+2v\\\left.\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|_{(0,2)} & =\left(2 v - \sin{\left(u \right)}\right)\big|_{u=0,v=2}\\& =2 (2) - \sin{\left((0) \right)}\\& =4\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Area}(T(Δ)) & \approx|4|\cdot\delta A\\ & =4\,\delta A.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
T:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}\longrightarrow\begin{bmatrix}u^{3} - v\\- u + v\end{bmatrix}?
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Recall that the absolute value of the Jacobian determinant gives the local area scale factor of the transformation at that point:

$$
\text{Area}(T(Δ))\approx\left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|\cdot\underbrace{\text{Area}(Δ)}_{\delta A}
$$

Computing the corresponding Jacobian determinant, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)} & =\begin{vmatrix}\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}\\\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}&\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}\end{vmatrix}\\& =\begin{vmatrix}3 u^{2}&-1\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\\& =(3 u^{2})\cdot (1)-(-1)\cdot (-1)\\& =3u^{2}-1\\\left.\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|_{(-4,-4)} & =\left(3 u^{2} - 1\right)\big|_{u=-4,v=-4}\\& =3 (-4)^{2} - 1\\& =47\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Area}(T(Δ)) & \approx|47|\cdot\delta A\\ & =47\,\delta A.\end{aligned}

$$

$$
question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
\text{Area}(T(Δ))\approx\left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|\cdot\underbrace{\text{Area}(Δ)}_{\delta A}

$$
